items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: Sal Turner was a guitar, and you had the nose whistle. That's right. And there was the four of you on it. Four of us.

ctx.x: He lived here already. He was an original Louisville Jug Band. Mm-hmm. That, they're the names you don't can't remember the banjo. Mm-hmm.

Well, this is the group that made the Paramount, anyway, and you used a nose whistle on that. Yeah. And it was called Jones So Different Four. So Different Four. Uh, Sal Turner was a guitar, and you had the nose whistle. That's right. And there was the four of you on it. Four of us. Um, did you make other titles than this?
No, I never made but one record.
